info.name: Get audio content result and status

params.name: job_id
params.description: The job_id returned by a generate request.

items.docs: Retrieves the status of an audio generation job. When finished, returns the generated script and an MP3 download URL. Errors are reported via the error and error_details fields.

info.name: Get podcasts for the authenticated user

items.docs: Returns the podcasts associated with the authenticated API key.
